detailed_description: The VAT Calculator computes Value Added Tax (VAT) across European countries and custom tax rates directly in your browser. It supports standard, reduced, and super-reduced rates for EU member states, allowing you to add VAT to a net amount, exclude VAT from a gross price, or calculate the standalone tax portion. Built-in country presets provide updated tax rates, while custom rate overrides let you test specific B2B pricing scenarios, invoice calculations, and international cross-border sales.
usage_steps: Enter the base monetary amount in the input field
Choose whether to add VAT to net amount or remove VAT from gross amount
Select an EU country preset or check 'Custom Rate' to enter an exact percentage
Pick standard, reduced, or zero rate categories where applicable
Review the calculated net, VAT tax, and gross total figures instantly
usage_examples: Calculate VAT for invoices and business transactions across European partners
Determine net price from VAT-inclusive retail prices for bookkeeping
Compare VAT rates across different EU member countries before pricing products
Compute custom local tax percentages for international freelance invoices

faqs.question: How do I calculate VAT?
faqs.answer: To add VAT: Gross = Net × (1 + Rate/100). To remove VAT from a gross price: Net = Gross / (1 + Rate/100). The calculator handles both formulas automatically.

faqs.question: Which EU countries and VAT rates are supported?
faqs.answer: It includes standard and reduced VAT presets for EU member states (such as Germany 19%/7%, France 20%/10%/5.5%, Spain 21%/10%/4%), as well as custom rate inputs.

faqs.question: Does this tool store financial figures or send them to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All calculations run strictly in your browser session without storing or transmitting monetary data.
